results.remarks: Welcome to 1133 Fernleaf Ln, a beautifully upgraded, move-in ready residence nestled in one of Corona’s most desirable neighborhoods. Spanning a spacious 2,190 square feet of living space on an expansive 7,405 square foot lot, this home effortlessly blends modern luxury, functional design, and incredible outdoor appeal.From the moment you arrive, the pride of ownership is evident. Step through the front door to find a light, bright, and airy interior featuring fresh, designer paint throughout that perfectly complements the brand-new, premium luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring flowing across the main level. The heart of the home is the beautifully updated kitchen, which shines with freshly refaced cabinets equipped with high-end, soft-closing hinges for a whisper-quiet, luxury feel.Designed with modern flexibility in mind, the main level boasts a massive downstairs bedroom featuring two separate doorways. This layout is a rare find and provides the ultimate setup for a high-functioning home office, a quiet library, an entertainment room, or a private main-floor guest suite. Head upstairs to discover plush, brand-new carpeting that runs through the upper level, creating a cozy and comfortable retreat in the spacious bedrooms.Even the garage has been treated to premium upgrades. You will love the pristine epoxy flooring and the high-tech, space-saving side-mount (jackshaft) garage door opener. By mounting to the wall instead of the ceiling, it eliminates unsightly overhead tracks and maximizes your vertical storage space.The true crown jewel of this property is the massive, ultra-private backyard. Stepping outside, you will find an outdoor oasis with a dedicated, fenced-off garden area—perfect for growing your own fruits and vegetables. The rest of the yard features a sprawling, lush grass lawn with more than enough room for children and pets to play, host massive weekend barbecues, or build your dream custom swimming pool.Centrally located with easy access to local parks, premier shopping, dining, and excellent schools, 1133 Fernleaf Ln offers the turnkey California lifestyle you have been searching for. Don’t miss the opportunity to make this spectacular property your own!

results.remarks:
Welcome to the guard-gated 55+ community of Terramor in Temescal Valley. Situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on just shy of 11,000 sq. ft. lot, this expansive IronTree II model, the largest of its kind, offers one of the neighborhood's most private and generous homesites. Featuring 2 bedrooms + an office that can be used as a 3rd bedroom (buyer to install closet), 2 upgraded bathrooms, over 1,900 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, the home blends comfort and function.

The open-concept floor plan features soaring 10-foot ceilings, a striking 10-foot quartz kitchen island, thick quartz countertops, a farmhouse sink, fresh Designer Flat White interior paint, paid solar, an epoxy-coated two-car garage, and an extended driveway with parking for up to six vehicles.

The property is embraced by nature with surrounding hillsides, seasonal winter greenery, wildflowers, hummingbirds by day, and owls at night. Morning sunlight fills the home from the east while northern exposure provides afternoon shade.

The home is positioned with its back facing the ascending hills, offering sweeping skies and sunset views toward the Santa Ana Mountains. Sitting approximately four feet higher and five feet farther back into the lot than neighboring homes, it enjoys natural light, added privacy, and unobstructed views.

The property also includes numerous fire safety and resilience features, including a modern tile fire-retardant roof, an upgraded indoor fire sprinkler system with steel piping, an exterior fire hose spigot, and a fire hydrant located approximately 20 feet from the home. The adjacent emergency access road is designated exclusively for fire department use and serves as a fire access route, creating a quiet dead-end setting with no through traffic. Additional exterior features include brick perimeter walls and Terramor's community water storage system. The current homeowner paid under $1,001.15 annually for homeowners insurance during the last three years.

Residents of Terramor enjoy resort-style amenities including indoor and outdoor pools, a clubhouse with a bar and entertainment lounge, fitness center, spa, sauna, pickleball, tennis and bocce courts, fire pits, craft and game rooms, a community garden, scenic walking trails, dog parks, and additional recreational spaces.

results.remarks: A true Mid-Century masterpiece in the heart of Corona! Built in 1963 and offering approximately 2,850 square feet with 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, this one-of-a-kind home showcases dramatic architecture, walls of glass, soaring ceilings, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. A wide double-door entry with a large textured-glass window welcomes you inside, filling the foyer with natural light while maintaining privacy. From the moment you enter, your eyes are drawn to the massive great room with its spectacular vaulted wood-beam ceiling and incredible wall of glass. Eight oversized sliding glass doors topped by angular windows span much of the rear of the home, bringing in abundant natural light and beautiful views of the backyard, pool, palms, and mature landscaping. At the center of the room is a show-stopping Mid-Century fireplace with a dramatic suspended chimney descending from the ceiling. The spacious kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, granite countertops, a large center island, stainless steel appliances, and an atrium-style window over the sink. Both bathrooms have been beautifully updated, including a recently remodeled guest bath with shaker cabinetry, a large walk-in shower, and oversized window. The primary bath also features a walk-in shower and long horizontal window above the vanity. Spacious bedrooms offer large windows and ceiling fans. Additional features include a dedicated laundry room and storage room with built-in shelving. Major improvements include a newer roof, HVAC system, ductwork and vents, three-zone climate control, and updated fencing. Outside, the 10,454-square-foot lot is made for Southern California living with a pool and spa, new sod, fresh mulch, and an expansive concrete patio stretching across nearly the entire rear of the home beneath a large wood pergola. An oversized driveway provides abundant parking in addition to the two-car carport. Conveniently located near Corona's Historic District and exciting Downtown revitalization, including The HUB with new dining and businesses, plus the major transformation of historic City Park with planned recreation, gathering, aquatic, and outdoor amenities. Easy freeway access. A rare opportunity to own a distinctive piece of Corona's Mid-Century architectural character!

results.remarks: A beautiful home in a sought after neighborhood in West Corona and only 1 block from the Norco City Limits. Property has a very large lot of 13,504 sq. ft. with a pool and spa!!! This home features 5 bedrooms and 3 full baths. One bedroom is downstairs with full bath across the hall. Kitchen has granite countertops and large island with built-in storage. Also a walk-in pantry. Kitchen is open to Family room with fireplace. Flooring is beautiful with REAL hardwood throughout the house except the stairs, loft and upstairs landing are carpeted. Upstairs front bedroom has laminate flooring. All bathrooms are tile flooring. The Primary bedroom has a large retreat area with windows that overlook the backyard view of the pool/spa and fabulous Moon and Sunrises!!! City light views at night are spectacular!!! The Primary bathroom has tile flooring, double sinks, separate tub and shower and mirrored walk-in closet. There is added storage in the attic with access from upstairs with a pull down ladder. The property also has a Whole House Fan  upstairs!!! Large Loft upstairs with windows that overlook the front yard. Separate Laundry room downstairs with sink. 3 car Garage with built-in shelving. Extra concrete driveway on left side for RV or Boat parking. Front of house has a stone paved walkway and front porch patio. Plenty of grassy area front and backyard. There is a Pomegranate, Avocado, two Apple trees and two citrus trees that produce. Play set stays. Stagecoach Park is right around the corner. Close to the 91,15 and 71 freeways.  This property has lots of possibilities, one you can put your own creativness to. Do not miss looking at this property and what it has to offer!!!

This spacious two-story home offers 5 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, providing an ideal layout for comfortable family living and entertaining.

Step inside to an inviting open floor plan with generous living spaces and a spacious kitchen designed for everyday gatherings and entertaining. A highly desirable *edroom and full bathroom are conveniently located downstairs, perfect for guests, extended family, or a home office.

results.remarks:
Welcome to this stunning, highly upgraded home nestled in the prestigious Sycamore Creek master-planned community! Boasting an expansive open-concept floor plan, this impressive residence offers 6 spacious bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms (tax records reflect 5 bedrooms), providing ample space for multi-generational living, guests, and growing families.
From the moment you enter, you’ll appreciate the elegant custom tile flooring, crown molding throughout, and thoughtful upgrades that elevate every room. The main level features a private guest suite with its own full bathroom, perfect for visitors or extended family. Formal living and dining rooms create the perfect setting for entertaining, while the oversized family room showcases a cozy fireplace, a built-in entertainment center with pull-out drawers, and a surround sound system.
The gourmet kitchen is truly the heart of the home, featuring beautiful white cabinetry, granite countertops, designer tile backsplash, a massive center island, and a spacious walk-in pantry. Whether hosting holiday gatherings or casual family dinners, this space was designed to impress.
Upstairs, you’ll find a bright and airy loft/bonus room flooded with natural light, offering endless possibilities as a media room, game room, or home office. The luxurious primary suite serves as a private retreat with dual vanities, a soaking tub, separate oversized shower, and generous closet space. Brand-new upgraded carpeting throughout the upstairs bedrooms adds comfort and style.
Step outside to enjoy your private backyard oasis, complete with an enclosed patio perfect for year-round entertaining. Additional features include a 3-car tandem garage, large downstairs laundry room, ceiling fans throughout, and dual A/C units for optimal comfort.
Residents of Sycamore Creek enjoy resort-style amenities with low HOA fees, including sparkling pools, a state-of-the-art fitness center, scenic parks, walking trails, and community events. Just moments away, Deleo Regional Sports Park offers soccer and baseball fields, tennis and basketball courts, dog parks, skate parks, picnic areas, BBQ facilities, and endless outdoor recreation. Enjoy breathtaking mountain views, easy access to the 15 Freeway, nearby dining, golf courses, and hiking trails. Families will also appreciate being within walking distance to the highly acclaimed Todd Academy K-8 school.

results.remarks: Professionally designed and beautifully remodeled, this completely turn-key home blends timeless character with warm organic design.Throughout the home, layered textures, natural materials, and carefully curated finishes create a warm and inviting feel. The living room is anchored by a stone fireplace and expansive windows that flood the space with natural light, creating an inviting setting for gathering and relaxing. A second living space features an additional stone fireplace and sits adjacent to the kitchen, offering another comfortable area for spending time with family and friends. The kitchen has been completely redesigned with Taj Mahal quartzite countertops, soft taupe cabinetry, handcrafted Zellige tile, champagne bronze fixtures, and statement lighting. Ample cabinetry, generous counter space, and a functional layout make the kitchen both beautiful and practical. The primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat, featuring statement stone sconces, a built-in dresser, walk-in closet, and direct access to the backyard patio. The adjoining bathroom includes dual vanities, designer wallpaper, curated tile selections, and champagne bronze fixtures. Secondary bedrooms feature custom lighting, sliding closet doors, and built-in storage, while the secondary bathroom offers dual vanities, artisan tilework, a dedicated linen cabinet, and thoughtfully selected finishes. One of the standout features of the home is the oversized sunroom with built-in cabinetry and floating shelves. Whether used as a media room, home office, playroom, gym, reading room, or additional living area, the space offers exceptional flexibility. Sliding glass doors provide direct access to the backyard, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. Oak-toned flooring carries throughout the home, creating warmth and continuity from room to room. Warm woods, organic textures, natural stone, handcrafted tile, and curated finishes are layered throughout the home, adding depth, character, and a timeless sense of style. Designed for year-round enjoyment, the backyard offers plenty of space for outdoor entertaining, dining al fresco, gardening, or simply unwinding outdoors. Mature landscaping and an established avocado tree enhance the outdoor setting. With low property taxes, no HOA, and convenient access to nearby schools, shopping, dining, and freeways, this beautifully remodeled home offers an exceptional combination of design, comfort, and convenience.
